description.value: A ropy photosynthetic sessile that roots in the gravel of braided meltwater channels and grows only while the channel is running, which on that world is a matter of a few years before the water moves. Dried and plaited it makes the only cordage the dusk-band people have, and a reach that loses its channel loses its rope supply in the same season. Its growth rings record the life of a channel exactly, and the Consortium has used them to date settlement remains to within a year.
